isatvon_definition.i_instructions: Triggered by the Dify DMR's POST /tool/execute for skill_index 3 of Standard_BOM_Flow, after an OPTIONAL Costing Sheet file may have been uploaded via upload_server.py's POST /api/rfq/upload/costing_sheet (this endpoint's own docstring notes it replaces an earlier, now-unused ERP upload endpoint). Action: validate rfq_id, look up a registered Costing Sheet file (file_role='COSTING_SHEET'); if present, run process_costing_sheet() and write standardized rows to DuckDB's costing_sheet table under a cross-process lock. Check: rfq_id format guard, write result status=='success'. Bound: single attempt, no retry loop. Business rule: unlike QuoteWin, a MISSING Costing Sheet file is NOT a failure -- the tool gracefully returns status:'skipped' and the pipeline proceeds without costing-sheet enrichment for this RFQ.

fresh_state_parameters: Whether a row exists in file_metadata_db.rfq_file_telemetry with file_role='COSTING_SHEET', is_active=true, for (rfq_id, version) -- this is genuinely optional, not just a fallback
version (integer, default 1, resolved by fastapi_router.py's active-version lookup)

a_automation.action_step: Attempt to fetch the Costing Sheet file path via postgres_metadata__execute_sql; if found, run process_costing_sheet(costing_sheet_file) and write to DuckDB's costing_sheet table inside db.duckdb_file_lock().
a_automation.acceptance_check: If no file was registered: acceptance is status=='skipped' (a success path, not a failure). If a file was found: acceptance is the write result's status=='success'.

t_tech_stack.action_tool: standardize_costing_sheet (this tool itself, plus process_costing_sheet / process_costing_sheet_to_database helper functions)
t_tech_stack.fixed_check_tool: None -- no independent validation MCP tool exists; validation is inline.

v_variables.success_gate: result['status']=='success' OR result['status']=='skipped' (both are non-failure terminal states for this specific tool)
v_variables.no_op_condition: No Costing Sheet file registered for this rfq_id -- returns status:'skipped' with reason text, distinct from standardize_scrub_bom's already_processed-based no-op
v_variables.escalation_condition: None -- this tool never sets hitl:1; it has no gate of its own
v_variables.budget_limit: 300s MCP Jungle call_tool() timeout / 600s Dify HTTP node timeout -- same real values as the other scrub_mcp_server tools

o_outcome.state_handoff_file: No dedicated append-only audit table exists. Real state handoff is the written costing_sheet DuckDB rows (when not skipped), plus PostHog upload_processing_started/completed/skipped/failed events.

ui_updates: Generic {skillCode:'M03.3_CostingSheetStandardize', skillName:'Standardize Costing Sheet (optional)', stepStatus} pushed via fastapi_router.py's notify_skill_progress()
database_updates: file_metadata_db.rfq_process_tracking.rfq_process_stage incremented by fastapi_router.py on either 'success' or 'skipped' (both are treated as non-hitl advances)
alerts: None confirmed beyond the SSE progress events

persistence.database: DuckDB (input_db.duckdb) for output; PostgreSQL file_metadata_db for file-path lookup
persistence.table: costing_sheet (DuckDB, written when a file exists); rfq_file_telemetry (Postgres, read)
persistence.action: Direct DuckDB write under db.duckdb_file_lock() when a file exists; otherwise no write occurs

ui.method: SSE push via the daemon's rfq:skill-progress channel
